response.sql: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo), shares AS (SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, 1.0 * employee_count / SUM(employee_count) OVER () AS share FROM group_counts) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(ReportsTo AS TEXT), '') AS ReportsTo, employee_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average FROM shares ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC, ReportsTo ASC LIMIT 10;
